# Thilaka Ayurveda — Complete Knowledge Reference

Last reviewed: 2026-11-23
Canonical website: https://www.thilakaayurveda.lk/

## 1. Verified Business Identity & Location

- **Business Name:** Thilaka Ayurveda
- **Business Type:** Traditional Ayurvedic medicine shop and herbal-product retailer
- **Physical Shop Address:** No. 38, Main Street, Ruwanwella, Sri Lanka
- **Telephone:** +94 36 226 6693 (`tel:+94362266693`)
- **Stated Establishment Year:** 1982 (stated on the official Thilaka Ayurveda website; family-operated business guided by traditional Ayurvedic knowledge)
- **Opening Hours Policy:** Please call +94 36 226 6693 before visiting to confirm current opening hours and public or Poya holiday arrangements.
- **Directions URL:** https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Thilaka+Ayurveda,+No.+38,+Main+Street,+Ruwanwella,+Sri+Lanka

## 2. Catalogue-Only Purchase Rule & Medical Notice

- **Purchase Notice:** This website is a product catalogue only. Online purchases and orders are not available. Customers cannot buy, order, pay, reserve items, or arrange delivery online. To purchase a product, please visit our shop at No. 38, Main Street, Ruwanwella, Sri Lanka. Contact us at +94 36 226 6693 to ask about product information or current availability before visiting.
- **General Health Notice:** Information on this website is provided for general product and business information. It is not a substitute for diagnosis, treatment, or advice from a qualified healthcare professional. Product ingredients, directions, suitability, and availability should be confirmed for each product before use. Customers with medical conditions, pregnant or breastfeeding individuals, and people taking prescription medication should consult a qualified healthcare professional before using relevant products.

## 3. Traditional Ayurvedic Preparation Forms (5 Classical Forms)

| Form | Subtitle | Plain-Language Summary | Typical Format | Shop Verification Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Churna | Fine Herbal Powders | Traditional powdered herbal preparations. | Dry milled botanical powder | Confirm pack sizes, ingredients, and label directions at our Ruwanwella shop. |
| Vati / Gutika | Herbal Tablets & Pills | Traditional herbal tablets or pills. | Compressed tablets or herbal pills | Speak with staff by phone or in person to check current availability and label instructions. |
| Medicated Oils | Herbal Infused Oils (Taila) | Herbal oils intended for specified applications. Product-specific directions must be confirmed. | Bottled botanical oil infusion | Confirm external/topical usage instructions, warming notes, and contraindications before use. |
| Arishta / Asava | Fermented Herbal Liquids | Traditional fermented herbal liquid preparations. | Liquid herbal tonic / decoction | Call or visit the shop to confirm available formulations, bottle sizes, and label directions. |
| Raw Herbs | Fresh & Dried Botanicals | Fresh or dried herbal ingredients, subject to availability. | Whole, cut, or dried plant parts | Seasonal availability varies; call +94 36 226 6693 before visiting to confirm stock. |

## 5. Services & Core Values

### Core Values
- **Tradition:** Respect for Ayurvedic knowledge, classical preparation forms, and heritage passed down since 1982.
- **Care:** Helpful, unhurried, and respectful customer attention when you visit our shop or call with questions.
- **Quality:** Careful attention to product quality, authentic botanical ingredients, and accurate product information.
- **Transparency:** Clear communication about ingredients, preparation forms, shop availability, and scope of information.
- **Responsibility:** Avoiding unsupported health claims and encouraging guidance from qualified healthcare professionals.

### In-Shop Services
1. **Traditional Ayurvedic Product Retail (In-Shop Purchase at Ruwanwella):** Browse and buy traditional Ayurvedic medicines, herbal preparations, medicated oils, and natural wellness products physically at No. 38, Main Street, Ruwanwella.
2. **Product Guidance & Availability Enquiries:** Enquire in store or by calling +94 36 226 6693 to learn about categories, preparation forms, label information, and availability.
3. **Personalized Herbal Preparations:** Subject to in-shop review and confirmation. Contact the Ruwanwella shop directly to confirm which formulations can currently be prepared and whether practitioner authorization is required.
4. **Fresh & Dried Raw Herbal Ingredients:** Seasonal supply subject to harvest and shop stock. Call ahead before visiting to verify specific herbs or quantities.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions

1. **Where is the Thilaka Ayurveda shop located?**
   Our physical shop is located at No. 38, Main Street, Ruwanwella, Sri Lanka. Call +94 36 226 6693 or use our Google Maps directions link on the Contact page.
2. **Can I purchase or order products through this website?**
   No. This website is a product catalogue and information guide only. Online orders, shopping carts, online payments, product reservations, and delivery requests are not available. To purchase any product, please visit our physical shop in Ruwanwella.
3. **How can I check whether a specific product or raw herb is available?**
   Product and seasonal raw herb availability can change daily. Before travelling to Ruwanwella, call +94 36 226 6693 or prepare an availability enquiry on our Contact page with the category or product name you are looking for.
4. **What are Thilaka Ayurveda's opening hours?**
   Opening schedules may vary on weekends and Sri Lankan public or Poya holidays. Please call +94 36 226 6693 before visiting to confirm our current opening days and hours.
5. **What types of Ayurvedic product forms are available at Thilaka Ayurveda?**
   Offerings span Churna (herbal powders), Vati / Gutika (herbal tablets or pills), Medicated Oils (herbal infused oils), Arishta / Asava (fermented herbal liquid preparations), and fresh or dried Raw Herbs, subject to shop availability.
6. **What is the difference between Churna, Vati / Gutika, Medicated Oils, and Arishta / Asava?**
   Churna refers to finely ground dried herbal powders; Vati / Gutika are measured herbal tablets or pills; Medicated Oils are botanical oil infusions intended for specified topical or traditional applications; and Arishta / Asava are traditional fermented herbal liquid preparations.
7. **Does Thilaka Ayurveda offer personalized or custom herbal preparations?**
   Thilaka Ayurveda's service scope includes personalized herbal preparations. Please contact the Ruwanwella shop directly at +94 36 226 6693 to confirm which formulations can currently be prepared and what consultation or authorization applies.
8. **Does Thilaka Ayurveda supply fresh and dried raw herbs?**
   Yes, fresh and dried raw herbal ingredients are part of our offering, subject to seasonal harvesting and current counter stock. Call +94 36 226 6693 prior to visiting to confirm specific botanicals and quantities.
9. **How can I verify ingredients, pack sizes, and usage directions before purchasing?**
   Individual product labels, ingredient lists, pack sizes, storage notes, and manufacturer directions can be reviewed directly at our shop counter at No. 38, Main Street, Ruwanwella, or clarified by calling +94 36 226 6693 before your visit.
10. **Does the website provide personal medical advice or diagnoses?**
    No. All descriptions on this website are general catalogue and business information only and do not substitute for diagnosis, treatment, or advice from a qualified healthcare professional.
